dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - August 09, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Nationals Dominate Reds, Manaea Shines in Mets Rout**

The Washington Nationals cruised to a 7-1 victory over the Cincinnati Reds behind a dominant pitching staff effort. Abimelec Ortiz led the offense with a two-hit, one-home-run performance, while Will Dion earned the win. The New York Mets also had a big day, defeating the Pittsburgh Pirates 11-1 behind Sean Manaea's seven-inning, 11-strikeout outing. Luis Robert Jr. hit a home run and drove in four runs for the Mets.

In other games, the Atlanta Braves edged the New York Yankees 2-1 behind Cam Schlittler's seven-inning, 11-strikeout performance, and the Minnesota Twins lost to the Milwaukee Brewers 4-3 despite Jacob Misiorowski's six-inning, nine-strikeout effort. The Los Angeles Angels were roughed up by the Miami Marlins 12-3, with Grayson Rodriguez taking the loss despite four strikeouts in four innings.
